title: Princeton studies of Geller

tellings.quote: they're they even have like a some papers where they studied him at Princeton and

plain: A man named Geller was studied by researchers at Princeton University in New Jersey, and there are papers about it, according to Michels. He mentions it in passing, citing a friend at the Princeton parapsychology lab (a lab that studied claimed psychic abilities), and says "they even have like some papers where they studied him at Princeton."
